title: New Releass: 6 New Packs for RPG Maker !

posts.author: RPGMakerWeb
posts.body:
6 New packs are here from GGG!
​
Search castle dungeons filled with locked doors and creepy mansions where vampires rule with the Dark Castle Assets Top View Ver pack! ESQUADRA,inc. is here with a small pack of pixel art tiles to add a new interior location for your hero to visit. Sneak into libraries filled with secret knowledge, rescue friends from cages underground jails, catch your breath in a cushy bedroom, and collect gold, gems, and potions before facing off against the ruler of this castle with this pack!
3 stone walls, 3 stone floors, and 3 carpets can be mixed and matched to create varied wings and floors in a castle, or use the darker stone and red carpet to subtly warn your players that they’re heading for a dangerous area. Fill long hallways with spooky armor and stone statues placed between pillars and archways, and show that magic is affecting this castle with glowing crystals lighting up the rooms and every window showing only darkness outside. Stock an armory with training dummies and weapon racks, or avoid that room and its possible dangers by sticking to the storage rooms stuffed with crates and barrels. Canopied beds and large fireplaces can turn stone rooms into comfortable places to sleep, and fill a throne room with marble stairs leading to a wooden throne or a coffin marked with bat wings. This pack also includes 3 wooden door sprites and a blond hero character sprite and face image to send into your creepy castles! Explore pixelated hallways and spooky throne rooms with the Dark Castle Assets Top View Ver pack!
Purchase Now on
KOMODO Plaza
or on
Steam
!
​
Fill your towns with shops, lookout points, and unique homesteads with the EX Graphic Village Expansion! Zepharex is back with another set of tiles that match their incredible EX Graphic Base Set Outdoor pack, this time offering up premade buildings and detailed walls and roofs to fill once-empty towns with shopping districts, fishy harbors, and more! A1, A2, A3, and A5 sheets are perfect for adding new additions to your towns and villages with a wide selection of ground, wall, and roof tiles, and 5 B sheets include a number of prebuilt houses and small decorative tiles to easily turn small villages into bustling towns.
Dot your wilder areas with wooden homes topped with thatched roofs so your heroes can take a break while exploring, or create cozy villages where the biggest building is the local church with its bright stone walls and stained glass windows. Protect a town from monster attacks with tall gray walls around the town, and keep NPCs and wannabe heroes from falling to their death with metal railings and diagonal fences atop those walls and around open water. Create a harbor for your cities where barnacle-encrusted docks lead out to small wooden boats that can be stocked with fishing nets, and set up an inn near the docks for all the new arrivals to stay at when they get off their ships. Give your heroes helpful places to shop by adding magic shops attached to a glass-domed tower and armor shops with burning furnaces ready to sell your heroes new equipment, or stick a mysterious tower in the middle of the town’s lake to draw your players’ attention until they finally finish the right side quests to visit the tower and the powerful mage who lives there. Pick up the EX Graphic Village Expansion and add even more gorgeous homes and shops to your game’s towns!
Purchase Now on
KOMODO Plaza
or on
Steam
!
​
Ditch the boring wasps and goblins in battles and force your heroes to face off against mystical monsters and magical horrors with the NATHUHARUCA MEGA MONSTER PACK! NATHUHARUCA is back with another massive set of monster battler images each with at least 10 color variations to really add more options to your game. Get ready to battle a skeletal sorcerer who’s not playing with a full deck of cards, a fanged fungus, a decomposing dragon, an unknown mass of gelatinous evil, and more with this pack!
30 unique monsters offer up a variety of designs to populate your dungeons. Fill your volcano with burning hellhounds and stone creatures that erupt flames from their spikes, and your forests with elven warriors and two-headed plants. Or make sure that your players keep different tactics in mind by having them face off against wizards that have fused with their own magic who can only be hurt with magic-based skills and demons stitched together from multiple monsters that can absorb every type of attack except physical damage. Challenge them with battles against possessed swords and winged shields, and teach them early to destroy portals that can summon new enemies onto the battlefield!  Each battler also comes in two sizes, so you can choose a larger version to better fit your screen resolution or use both sizes in battle to show your players when they’re facing off against a miniboss and its minions. If your game needs some creative creatures for your heroes to fight, check out the NATHUHARUCA MEGA MONSTER PACK!
Purchase Now on
KOMODO Plaza
or on
Steam
!
​
Give your heroes some awesome techno tracks to bop along to while facing evil in a digital world with PearFinch’s Cybernetic Battle BGM pack! PearFinch is here with 23 looping BGM tracks to fill your maps with electronic beats and synth melodies. Find the right songs to defeat AI-controlled robots, disrupt criminal hideouts, recover from a major loss, find a powerful ancient tool, and more with this pack!
Race through a collapsing internet while the heavy beat and quirky twangs ‘Bullet Viscera’ plays in the background, or make use of its 7 minute runtime to keep longer battles feeling fresh with its engaging tunes. Keep the energy up in fights with ‘Gold to Gold’s upbeat synths or with the toe-tapping electronics of ‘Lightning Superweapon’. Or focus the music on enhancing your maps with ‘Hidden Factory’ perfect for a warehouse dungeon filled with surprises and ‘Cathedral of the Machine’ ready to give your city’s safe spaces a noble air with synth keyboards and flowing melodies. Set your players on edge with the strange robotic whirring that leads into a speedy techno beat of ‘Odd Situation’ or the robotic voices in ‘Strange Soul’ and give them a chance to breathe with the calmer pace of ‘All Systems Offline’.
Each track comes in M4a and Ogg file formats, so you can easily add them to your MV/MZ projects, or use them in your favorite engine. Pick up PearFinch’s Cybernetic Battle BGM pack and give your cyberpunk or sci-fi games an incredible electronic soundtrack to tie it all together!
Purchase Now on
KOMODO Plaza
or on
Steam
!
​
Let a single instrument shine in some of your scenes with the Piano Battle & Fantasy Music Pack! NAKATOMO has crafted 13 BGM tracks that focus solely on a piano to create soft tunes that complement a small village or a world where the scariest monster you’ll face is the decision between selling potatoes or strawberries. Use these tracks to let your players know that an area is safe or to help make sure your players are focused on the emotional cutscene in front of them and not on bombastic tunes!
5 Battle tracks and 8 Fantasy tracks offer up a variety of melodies to fit different emotions and themes. Use the battle tracks to set the stage when confronting an enemy, or when your heroes are in a hurry to rescue the princess! Give a forest town a mysterious air around it with notes dancing along the keys or have upbeat scales welcome the heroes into the town. Introduce important characters with the same tinkling tune, and bid them farewell with slow, longing notes.
Each track comes in M4a and Ogg file formats so you can drop them right into your MV/MZ games or use them in your favorite engine. So if your game could use some calming piano tunes in certain scenes or you want to have some diegetic music in your taverns, check out the Piano Battle & Fantasy Music Pack!
Purchase Now on
KOMODO Plaza
or on
Steam
!
​
Fill your pixelated world with catchy chiptunes thanks to the Retro Game Console Sound BGM Set 2! MML Hack-a-thon is back with another music pack created using sound sources from retro game hardware, so these tracks sound like they just came from the 80s and 90s ready to give your old-school inspired games some fitting tunes. 21 BGM tracks are ready to add more flair to your villages, dungeons, battles, and emotional cutscenes, and to get your players into the right mood to enjoy your games!
Choose from 8 different stage BGMs to give each of your dungeons their own upbeat tracks, or use multiple as battle tracks so that your players never know what tune they’ll be bobbing their heads to while knocking out enemy troops. Visit villages where happy tracks play in the background, and get your players hyped when they buy a new weapon with an energetic blast of music. Or grab some of these tracks and use them in arcade minigames as a homage to your favorite childhood games while the rest of your modern game has its own musical style.
This pack also includes 5 MEs to help set up stages and dungeons in your game, and to give your players a dopamine boost when they hear the upbeat chirps that mean they’ve won a battle. Each track comes in M4a and Ogg file formats so you can add them to your MV/MZ projects, or use them in your favorite engine. Check out Retro Game Console Sound BGM Set 2 and add some more chiptune bops to your retro game!

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
Okay, I'm officially dyslexic, I guess... I did read "New 6 packs for RPG maker", so I thought we got graphics for muscle and fitness enthusiasts.
I already had so many ideas for a gym-romance or a Conan the Barbarian tribute.
Would have been fun to have Chibi Schwarzenegger.
(I didn't really have idea's for the muscle graphics... Made those up on the spot... Just because it was funny. I did really think it was about 6-packs, though.)

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body:
I got myself PearFinch’s Cybernetic Battle BGM, and I have to say it is quite nice. You can listen to the entire score
here
by the way. If I had to nitpick... it's kind of a shame that some of the more juicy bits are right in the middle of the longer tracks, requiring the need for some cutting, something in which I have zero skill. But then again, the price is good, so... the jacket is nice too.
And yes, the preview images of NATHUHARUCA's monster pack made me want to click away upon opening their steam page.

posts.author: The_Eerie_One
posts.body:
Really digging the Dark Castle  Assets Top View Ver set - hoping that "Ver" means there'll be more versions in that style in the future, would love to make a game in that style some day.
Of course I still need to finish the game I'm already working on...
Especially love those 2 character designs, cute.

posts.body:
Trudel said:
But the mega monster pack... man what are those preview images?
Click to expand...
That maker has a number of other packs...the monster packs are all pretty unintelligible, in terms of getting a sense of what the monsters actually look like.
And the tile packs are poorly-drawn, with perspectives that don't match RPG Maker's camera angle and stuff like that. So now I just see the name and know I'm not interested in the product.
